data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter library for working with FHIR resources across multiple versions.
data.what_it_does: Provides models and helpers for working with FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) data standards for versions R4, STU3, DSTU2, and R5 in Dart and Flutter. Includes support for parsing, primitives, and serialization.
use_when: You need to build healthcare applications interacting with FHIR APIs
You are working with FHIR standards R4, STU3, DSTU2, or R5
avoid_when: You are starting a new project, as this package is now considered legacy and largely unmaintained
You only need the R4 version (use fhir_r4 instead)
strengths: Includes helpful data classes, primitives, and timezone handling for FHIR data
weaknesses: Rapidly becoming a legacy package with limited active maintenance
Too large for pub.dev to publish in full form, leading to removed versions like dstu2 and r6 in certain contexts
